meta.scope: Secure triage of written customer support for the fictional telco NordTel GmbH.
meta.disclaimer: Portfolio project. Synthetic data only. Not a certification; nothing here is 'certified', 'compliant' or 'audit-ready'. Standard text is never copied; only control IDs plus my own-words titles are used.
meta.format: soa.json reuses the shape from my iso27001-evidence-as-code project: a flat list of controls, each with id, own-words title, applicability, how it is implemented here, and the code/evidence that backs it.

controls.title: Sender-trust check on written messages (my words)
controls.implemented: Parse .eml, read SPF/DKIM/DMARC from Authentication-Results, return an explainable trust verdict.

controls.title: Rule-based phishing flags (my words)
controls.implemented: Heuristics for fake invoice, lookalike domain and urgent payment link; records which rule matched.

controls.title: Mask personal data before any model call (my words)
controls.implemented: Reversible masking with an in-memory token map; no raw PII reaches the model, handoff or log.

controls.title: Local classification over my own category descriptions (my words)
controls.implemented: Local retrieval scores my own categories; a pluggable LLM picks from candidates; offline default for CI.

controls.title: Prompt-injection detector on masked text (my words)
controls.implemented: Rule-based detector runs on the masked text; on a hit, no tool use is permitted.

controls.title: No auto-execution of account-changing actions (my words)
controls.implemented: Tariff change, cancellation, address change and SEPA change create a pending approval for a human; read-only answers proceed.

controls.title: AI transparency line on machine output (my words)
controls.implemented: Every machine-generated output carries a disclosure that an automated system handled the message.

controls.title: Queue out-of-hours requests instead of closing (my words)
controls.implemented: Outside 07:00-23:00 the request is queued with an ETA; it is never silently closed.

controls.title: Tamper-evident audit log (my words)
controls.implemented: Hash-chained JSONL: each line stores the previous line's SHA-256; no raw PII is logged.
